name: com.mhze.dialog-system
description: Simple, adjustable Canvas dialog system. ScriptableObject dialog sequences with per-line speaker, text, duration and voice-over; a Canvas UI view with optional typewriter reveal; a central DialogManager with advance/auto-advance, events and a runtime PlayLines shortcut; and a DialogProximityTrigger that starts a conversation when the player comes within range. Includes an editor setup wizard that builds the Canvas UI.
